P1.supportQuote: Phase 3 - Post Only Mode ... This phase is generally active for 5 - 10 minutes before each planned maintenance.
P1.sotQuote: Step 1: Market is put into post-only mode. Traders are able to post and/ or cancel limit orders. However, at time time, orders are not matched.
P1.summary: Support article states Post Only Mode is active '5-10 minutes before each planned maintenance', but it is actually a post-maintenance resumption phase (not a pre-maintenance phase), as described in the SoT Trading Resumption Process.

P1.summary: Support article says users cannot cancel/edit open positions in Phase 1 (Cancel Only Mode), but the SoT describes Phase 1 as allowing cancellation of existing orders with no mention of a position-editing restriction beyond new orders.

conflicts.guidesQuote:
Phase 1: Order book is put in cancel-only mode and no new orders are accepted. Thus, traders have the option to cancel any existing orders.
Phase 2: Order book is completely frozen and, new order or cancellations are accepted and no matches occur.
conflicts.docsQuote: When markets are disrupted, orderbook enters into cancel only mode. You can refer to "trading_status" field in product info to determine this. In cancel only mode, you can only cancel your orders. No matching happens in this mode.
conflicts.summary: Guides describe two distinct pre-maintenance phases (cancel-only then fully frozen), while docs describe market disruption as a single cancel-only mode state with no mention of a subsequent fully-frozen phase.
